_doc: Declared report families: several reports of ONE trial at different follow-up times. Read by harness/report_family.py, which re-hashes every witness, requires its span verbatim, parses the follow-up from the span, and selects the report matching the protocol's timepoint; every other report is a SENSITIVITY_CANDIDATE, and the family counts as ONE trial.

colchicine-secondary-cv-prevention.declared_by: evidence lane (Claude Opus 5.5), 2026-09-27, from the reviewer's COPS report-family fixture

reports.label: COPS 12-month primary report (Tong et al., Circulation 2020;142:1890-1900)
reports.planned_follow_up_note: the same abstract states patients 'were followed up for a minimum of 12 months': 12 months is the minimum, not the trial end
reports.result_state: SOURCE_RETRIEVED (abstract held in the topic cache)

reports.label: COPS 2-year follow-up (Tong et al., Circulation 2021;144:1584-1586, research letter)

follow_up_witness.span: Two-Year Follow-Up of the Australian COPS Randomized Clinical Trial

reports.retrieved_via: acquisition cascade (evidence/acquisition_cascade/ATTEMPTS.jsonl, target COPS#24m): DOI resolved to PMID 34748393 by Europe PMC
reports.result_state_basis: research letter with no abstract; not in the Europe PMC open-access subset; publisher PDF refused the honest client (HTTP 403, not retried); the repository copy Unpaywall listed as CC-BY is 'All Rights Reserved' on figshare with no files. The 24-month result is not held, so it is neither pooled nor refused on its numbers.
